conviction_note: H1 was pre-released on 10-06 (OP 10.0->12.8bn); the 10-09 print carries the withheld full-year forecast and dividend, which this company has raised at every Q2 for three years. Carrying the H1 beat through on the original H2 plan gives FY OP ~19.8bn against a stale IFIS 19.07bn, and the 40% total-return policy points to a dividend around 190 yen against 160. Against that: the pre-release pop has been fully given back and margin longs are crowded at 22.6x. Hence abs 5.0 (the proxy 4.22, raised because a guide and a dividend land) and p_up 58, giving +0.8, a little below the +1.2 findings sum because the H2 guide could be set cautiously (pull-forward, memory-parts caution).

findings.finding: The full-year forecast is held back for this print and is very likely raised: H1 OP was pre-released at 12.8bn against a 10.0bn plan, and keeping the original H2 plan (7.0bn) gives FY OP ~19.8bn and ordinary ~20.7bn. Those are about 4% and 3% above an IFIS consensus (19.07bn / 20.03bn) that has not moved since before the H1 revision. The company raised FY at Q2 in 2023, 2024 and 2025, and in Oct 2025 it raised FY ordinary by 50bn yen against a 31bn H1 beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025 analog: H1 pre-released 10-03 (stock +17.9%, +8.3% over the next sessions), FY raised 125->175bn ordinary plus a +40 yen dividend at the 10-10 15:30 print; next session +1.53% while the Nikkei fell 2.58%, then +5.2%, +8.2% over the following days. Apr 2026 guide +13.7%; Jul 2026 Q1 stop-high +15.65%; Jan 2026 Q3 with FY held -4.0% (出尽くし).
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is at 8040, below the 8130 close before the 10-06 H1 revision: +3.69% on 10-07 was given back on 10-08 (-5.22% vs Nikkei -1.42%), so the price holds no FY raise above the stale consensus. If the market had priced a raise to ~20bn OP, the pre-release pop would have held, and the IFIS ordinary consensus would have moved off 20,030m (it was cut 3.5% and then 1% in September).
findings.independence: Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260708589735.pdf) says FY is running ahead of plan and was held only to buffer parts-procurement risk. Revision record on EDINET DB (https://edinetdb.jp/company/E01839/earnings-forecasts/). Same kabutan/minkabu revision release as finding 2.

findings.finding: The dividend forecast is explicitly 'under review, to be announced 10-09'. The mid-term plan targets a ~40% total return ratio with flexible buybacks, and the current 160 yen is ~39% of the 411 yen EPS plan, so an NP raise toward ~15bn (EPS ~475) implies about 190 yen or a buyback. The company raised the dividend at Q2 in 2023, 2024 and 2025 (+40 yen in Oct 2025).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025: +40 yen with the FY raise, next session +1.53% (+4.1% vs Nikkei). Apr 2026: prior-year DPS raised 150->160 and 160 held, +13.7% (mixed with the guide).
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus NP of 14.9bn implies ~188 yen at 40%, so an increase is partly expected by careful holders. What is not priced is the size: a dividend above ~190, or a buyback (the plan names 機動的な自社株買い), would land on a retail-heavy register (margin ratio 22.6x) that has given back the H1 pop.
findings.independence: Return policy restated in the 2026-04-09 cost-of-capital update (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260409/140120260409500676.pdf). The 'dividend under review' wording comes from the 10-06 revision notice (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6814&b=k202610060007), which is shared with finding 1. Both rest on the same NP raise, so I sized this one on the increment above the guide.

findings.finding: The H1 beat was not bought: the stock rose 3.69% on 10-07 and fell 5.22% on 10-08, ending below its pre-revision close, with leveraged margin longs at 22.6x their shorts and no disclosed short to squeeze. That is a sell-the-news setup unless the FY guide clearly clears ~20bn OP.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Jan 2026: after an Oct-Jan run, a solid Q3 with FY held drew -4.0% and -4.8% two sessions later (出尽くし, fisco https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6814&b=n202601130599). Oct 2025: -7.9% in session on print day before the release (outside this window's analog).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced already: the baseline lean (-0.97) carries the margin overhang, so this is sized small. What the lean does not carry is that the pre-release pop has been given back. That give-back means holders may sell a merely in-line guide rather than chase it.
findings.independence: Margin ratio from the sealed baseline's broker scrape; kabutan's margin page returned a CAPTCHA, so it is not independently confirmed. Part of the 10-08 drop was market-wide (AI/semis selling, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6814&b=n202610090121).

baseline_tension: The findings lean positive (+1.2) against a priced lean of -0.97 (margin overhang plus run-up). The strongest positive the release can carry, an FY raise plus a dividend increase or buyback, is the item I looked for: it is explicitly scheduled for this print and the company has delivered it three years running. The negative I hold is the crowded margin long and the given-back pre-release pop. So p_up is only 58.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (visible-miss negatives) does not apply because my only negative is positioning, not a 月次/進捗率 miss; rule 2 (check for the positive) is satisfied because the FY raise and dividend are the core of the file; open question 3 (a prior 修正 kills the event) does not apply because the 10-06 revision withheld FY and the dividend for this print, so the H1 lines are already sized at 0 and the remaining items are live
